source_instruction: i need some high fructose citrus tonic water.
query: Ugh, I just spent 20 minutes wandering the snack aisle looking for those sour watermelon gummy bears I loved as a kid, and I swear they moved them again—last time I found them they were tucked next to the fancy imported chocolate bars, and the cashier even gave me a weird look when I bought three bags last week. Oh, and I saw a guy drop a whole jar of pickles by the front entrance a minute ago, the glass shattered everywhere and staff were scrambling to clean it up before someone slipped. Anyway, since you probably don’t have any high fructose alcoholic drinks in stock right now, can you just show me the citrus-flavored ones that are under $120? Wait, actually—wait no, hold on, no—wait, actually I do need the high fructose ones first, right? Wait no, no, just, y’know, if you don’t have the high fructose ones the citrus ones are fine, as long as they’re under $120. Wait no, no—wait, high fructose is non-negotiable? Wait no, no, I already said if you don’t have it, citrus works, don’t overcomplicate it.
